headline: A tour-shaped swing — the measurements mostly sit inside the pro bands.

sections.title: What lined up well
sections.body: Inside the typical tour spread: how much the upper body leans at setup, the rhythm of the swing.

sections.title: Worth a look
sections.body: Your how far the shoulders rotate at the top measured more than most tour swings. Your how far the hips rotate at the top measured more than most tour swings. Your the gap between shoulder turn and hip turn at the top measured more than most tour swings. Your how open the hips are at impact measured more than most tour swings.

sections.title: Coach's read
sections.body:
Your spine angle, how much the upper body leans forward from standing upright, was within the typical spread of values seen across professional tour swings at address, the setup position, just before the swing starts. Your tempo, the timing and rhythm of the swing, was also within that typical spread.

At the top of the backswing, where the club changes direction, there was more separation between the shoulders and hips than in most tour swings. You already have some clear strengths in this swing.

sections.title: How to read this
sections.body: Every number here is measured from your video against a 400-swing tour reference — nothing is estimated by the AI. Ask the coach about any metric for the full story.
